quote: posed by Gauss in his Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, articles 303 and 304
note: Gauss wrote Disquisitiones Arithmeticae in 1798 and it was published in 1801. The class number problems appear in section V, articles 303 (imaginary quadratic fields) and 304 (real quadratic fields).
